job_description:
Entry-Level Backend Engineer (Python)

We are hiring a junior Python engineer to support API and data-pipeline delivery for our SaaS analytics platform.

Responsibilities:
• Implement REST endpoints with FastAPI or Django.
• Maintain PostgreSQL schemas and write optimized SQL queries.
• Build background jobs using Celery and Redis queues.
• Write unit/integration tests and participate in code reviews.
• Document services and deploy through our GitHub Actions pipeline.

Requirements:
• B.S. in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent internship experience).
• 0-1 years of professional software experience with Python.
• Familiarity with REST APIs, relational databases, and Git workflows.
• Understanding of containerization (Docker) and cloud fundamentals.

Nice to have:
• Exposure to AWS services (Lambda, RDS, ECS).
• Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Sentry).
resume:

PROJECTS

Knowledge Base Sync – Automated Confluence to Markdown sync using Python and AWS Lambda.

EDUCATION
B.S. Computer Science | Northeastern University | 2024

SKILLS
Python, FastAPI, Django, PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, Celery, Redis, Docker, Git, REST, pytest, CI/CD

competencies.name: Python Programming and Frameworks
competencies.rationale: The candidate needs a solid understanding of Python programming, particularly with frameworks like FastAPI or Django. A Concept Primer will help assess their foundational knowledge and ability to discuss key concepts.

competencies.name: Database Management and SQL Optimization
competencies.rationale: Given the requirement to maintain PostgreSQL schemas and write optimized queries, an Implementation Walkthrough will allow candidates to demonstrate their practical skills in database management.

competencies.name: Testing and Code Review Practices
competencies.rationale: The candidate must be able to write tests and participate in code reviews. A Scenario Drill will simulate real-world situations, testing their ability to apply these practices effectively.

criteria.name: Concept Understanding
criteria.description: Assess the candidate's foundational knowledge of Python programming, particularly with frameworks like FastAPI or Django.

scoring_levels.Level 0: Candidate cannot define key concepts and lacks understanding of framework basics.
scoring_levels.Level 1: Candidate provides vague definitions and shows limited practical examples.
scoring_levels.Level 2: Candidate defines key concepts but struggles to relate them to real-world applications.
scoring_levels.Level 3: Candidate explains concepts clearly with some relevant examples.
scoring_levels.Level 4: Candidate demonstrates a solid understanding of concepts with multiple relevant examples.
scoring_levels.Level 5: Candidate articulates deep insights into Python frameworks, providing comprehensive and practical examples.

criteria.name: Practical Application
criteria.description: Evaluate the candidate's ability to apply Python programming skills in real-world scenarios.

scoring_levels.Level 0: Candidate fails to demonstrate any practical application of Python skills.
scoring_levels.Level 1: Candidate shows minimal practical application with significant errors.
scoring_levels.Level 2: Candidate demonstrates basic application but lacks depth and accuracy.
scoring_levels.Level 3: Candidate applies Python skills effectively in simple scenarios.
scoring_levels.Level 4: Candidate applies Python skills proficiently in complex scenarios with minor issues.
scoring_levels.Level 5: Candidate showcases expert-level practical application of Python skills across diverse scenarios.

criteria.name: Framework Proficiency
criteria.description: Assess the candidate's proficiency and experience with FastAPI or Django frameworks.

scoring_levels.Level 0: Candidate has no knowledge of FastAPI or Django frameworks.
scoring_levels.Level 1: Candidate shows limited understanding and minimal hands-on experience.
scoring_levels.Level 2: Candidate demonstrates basic familiarity with framework features.
scoring_levels.Level 3: Candidate exhibits good proficiency in using the framework for standard tasks.
scoring_levels.Level 4: Candidate is proficient in advanced framework features and customization.
scoring_levels.Level 5: Candidate displays expert-level mastery of FastAPI or Django, including innovative uses.

criteria.name: Schema Design
criteria.description: Evaluate the candidate's ability to design efficient PostgreSQL schemas.

scoring_levels.Level 0: Candidate cannot design a basic schema and lacks understanding of database principles.
scoring_levels.Level 1: Candidate designs a flawed schema with significant inefficiencies.
scoring_levels.Level 2: Candidate creates a basic schema but overlooks optimization opportunities.
scoring_levels.Level 3: Candidate designs an efficient schema with some minor issues.
scoring_levels.Level 4: Candidate designs a highly optimized schema with minimal errors.
scoring_levels.Level 5: Candidate demonstrates expert-level proficiency in designing and optimizing schemas.

criteria.name: Query Optimization
criteria.description: Assess the candidate's ability to write and optimize SQL queries for performance.

scoring_levels.Level 0: Candidate writes inefficient queries with no optimization attempts.
scoring_levels.Level 1: Candidate shows minimal understanding of query optimization techniques.
scoring_levels.Level 2: Candidate applies basic optimization but lacks depth and accuracy.
scoring_levels.Level 3: Candidate optimizes queries effectively for standard use cases.
scoring_levels.Level 4: Candidate demonstrates advanced query optimization skills with minor issues.
scoring_levels.Level 5: Candidate exhibits expert-level mastery in writing highly optimized SQL queries.

criteria.name: Complexity Reasoning
criteria.description: Evaluate the candidate's ability to reason about time/space complexity and identify bottlenecks.

scoring_levels.Level 0: Candidate cannot explain or identify any aspects of query complexity.
scoring_levels.Level 1: Candidate shows limited understanding of complexity concepts.
scoring_levels.Level 2: Candidate identifies basic complexities but lacks depth in reasoning.
scoring_levels.Level 3: Candidate explains time/space complexity effectively for simple queries.
scoring_levels.Level 4: Candidate provides detailed analysis of query complexities with minor errors.
scoring_levels.Level 5: Candidate demonstrates expert-level understanding and reasoning about query complexities.

criteria.name: Test Creation
criteria.description: Assess the candidate's ability to write unit/integration tests.

scoring_levels.Level 0: Candidate cannot create any meaningful tests.
scoring_levels.Level 1: Candidate writes minimal tests with significant gaps in coverage.
scoring_levels.Level 2: Candidate creates basic tests but lacks thoroughness and accuracy.
scoring_levels.Level 3: Candidate writes effective tests covering most scenarios.
scoring_levels.Level 4: Candidate demonstrates proficiency in writing comprehensive tests.
scoring_levels.Level 5: Candidate exhibits expert-level skills in creating robust and efficient test suites.

criteria.name: Code Review Participation
criteria.description: Evaluate the candidate's ability to participate effectively in code reviews.

scoring_levels.Level 0: Candidate cannot engage meaningfully in code reviews.
scoring_levels.Level 1: Candidate shows minimal engagement with little constructive feedback.
scoring_levels.Level 2: Candidate participates but provides basic and sometimes inaccurate feedback.
scoring_levels.Level 3: Candidate engages effectively, offering relevant and accurate feedback.
scoring_levels.Level 4: Candidate demonstrates strong skills in providing insightful code review feedback.
scoring_levels.Level 5: Candidate exhibits expert-level proficiency in conducting thorough and constructive code reviews.

criteria.name: Tradeoff Analysis
criteria.description: Assess the candidate's ability to make reasoned trade-offs during testing and review.

scoring_levels.Level 0: Candidate cannot identify or analyze any trade-offs.
scoring_levels.Level 1: Candidate shows limited understanding of trade-off concepts.
scoring_levels.Level 2: Candidate identifies basic trade-offs but lacks depth in analysis.
scoring_levels.Level 3: Candidate analyzes trade-offs effectively for simple scenarios.
scoring_levels.Level 4: Candidate provides detailed trade-off analysis with minor errors.
scoring_levels.Level 5: Candidate demonstrates expert-level skills in analyzing and making reasoned trade-offs.
